description: Use this when the user requests verified daily technical analysis of one confirmed stock: SMA 20/50/200, RSI 14, trend states, momentum, price performance, ATR, relative volume and historical volatility. Where verified US daily history permits, advanced provides EMA, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Stochastic, support/resistance zones, recent dated crossovers and prior-session price ranges. Use advanced.referenceClose, currency and technicalAsOf for those levels, not the legacy price. Requires ValuEdge OAuth and uses one unit from the existing account research/valuation allowance; the same ledger and plan limits apply to web and MCP. The optional intelligence section adds reconciled daily/weekly trend, ADX/DMI, relative strength against available market and sector proxies, dated crossovers, divergence, volatility and zones. Use intelligence.reference for those results. Pattern evidence is available with Lite, Premium, Unlimited or an active Trial when verified history permits. If intelligence.patterns.trialNotice is returned, state its availability information once after the pattern findings, in the user's language; do not add this notice for other tiers or unavailable scans. Never infer a pattern, volume confirmation, missing indicators, intraday data or buy/sell instructions.
name: get_stock_technicals
title: Get stock technical analysis
